onboarding:slide.1.title: Every country, five minutes a day
onboarding:slide.1.title__note: First value slide headline. Concrete promise, no superlatives.
onboarding:slide.1.body: Flags, capitals and landmarks — learned in short bursts that fit in a bus ride.
onboarding:slide.1.body__note: Supporting line under the first slide headline.
onboarding:slide.2.title: Remembers what you forget
onboarding:slide.2.title__note: Second slide. Describes spaced repetition without naming it.
onboarding:slide.2.body: We bring a country back just before you'd lose it, so it sticks for good.
onboarding:slide.2.body__note: Supporting line. 'Just before you'd lose it' is the whole idea of the scheduler.
onboarding:slide.3.title: Collect the whole world
onboarding:slide.3.title__note: Third slide, about collection and progress.
onboarding:slide.3.body: 195 flags. 195 capitals. A map that fills in as you go.
onboarding:slide.3.body__note: Supporting line. The numbers are the real count of UN member states.
onboarding:cta.next__note: Advances to the next onboarding slide.
onboarding:cta.start__note: Primary button that leaves the value slides and begins setup.
onboarding:cta.haveAccount__note: Secondary action for returning users. Never styled as the primary.
onboarding:cta.skip__note: Skips the value slides. Always available — never trap a user in a carousel.
onboarding:age.title: When were you born?
onboarding:age.title__note: Age gate headline. Neutral date entry — NEVER 'are you over 13?', which teaches children to lie.
onboarding:age.body: This sets up the right experience for you. We don't share it with anyone.
onboarding:age.body__note: Explains why we ask. Must be true: the value stays on device until an account exists.
onboarding:age.year__note: Names the birth-year wheel for a screen reader — announced as the radiogroup label, not drawn on screen.
onboarding:age.continue__note: Confirms the birth year and moves to the goal picker.
onboarding:age.child.title: We'll keep things simple
onboarding:age.child.title__note: Shown to under-13s. Framed as a feature, never as a restriction or a punishment.
onboarding:age.child.body: No friends list, no ads, and nothing shared with anyone else. Just the learning.
onboarding:age.child.body__note: Explains the child branch in plain words a 10-year-old can read.
onboarding:goal.title: How much a day?
onboarding:goal.body: You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding:goal.body__note: Reassurance under the goal picker. Reduces the weight of the choice.
onboarding:goal.minutes__note: A daily goal option. {minutes} is 5, 10 or 20.
onboarding:goal.casual__note: Label for the 5-minute goal. Never framed as the lazy option.
onboarding:taster.title: Let's try one
onboarding:taster.title__note: Headline before the taster lesson. The user learns BEFORE we ask for an account.
onboarding:taster.body: One short lesson. No account needed.
onboarding:taster.body__note: Removes the expected friction. This promise must stay true.
onboarding:progress__note: Accessibility label for the onboarding progress BAR, which counts the four steps of the whole flow. Read aloud by screen readers.
onboarding:slide.position__note: Accessibility label for one dot in the intro carousel, which counts the three slides INSIDE step one. It used the bar's string, so a reader heard 'Step 2 of 4' from the bar and 'Step 1 of 3' from the dot beneath it — two answers to the same question. Different word for a different thing.
onboarding:age.none__note: The wheel's first row, and where it opens. Nothing is pre-selected here on purpose: this answer decides whether a child gets the child experience, so it must never be nudged. Phrase it as an invitation, never as an error or a missing value.
